Hi all,

Laura asked me to share a short legal playbook for sequencing so procurement has visibility. High level legal notes:

- DPA: We can accept most standard customer data protections; our preferred change is a narrow clause around subprocessor notification windows. We will provide a redline within 48 business hours after receiving VitalOps' standard DPA or your list of requested changes.

- MSA: We recommend executing the MSA first with an order form appended for pilot terms. The reason: it preserves commercial terms in the order form while allowing the MSA to handle broader legal terms (liability, IP). For VitalOps, signing the MSA + order form in the same DocuSign envelope is acceptable and would speed the process.

- Order Form: Please confirm the billing entity and PO format. We can accept vendor-specific PO references as long as a signed order form exists before start date.

- Timeline: For a clean path to Dec 20 pilot start I recommend: receive your DPA/standard redlines by EOD 26 Nov, Redwood returns redline by 30 Nov, finalize MSA/order form signature by 6 Dec (DocuSign), PO issued by 10 Dec. This assumes SOC 2 evidence is available in parallel.

I'm attaching a short MSA stub with placeholders to speed DocuSign setup.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Maya — adding the evaluation plan + acceptance criteria we propose for the pilot so procurement and engineering have clear handoffs.

Pilot evaluation plan (two-week pilot):
- Day 0 (onboarding): Account provisioning, KMS key exchange (if required), dataset handover (SFTP link). Owner: Priyom / VitalOps Eng.
- Day 1-5: Integration test: 5000 sample requests through Redwood API. Success = 99% availability during window + latency SLO met for 95th percentile.
- Day 6-10: Functional eval: 3 canonical workflows validated against your test prompts. Acceptance = 3/3 test sets within agreed thresholds.
- Day 11-14: Regression & consistency check; deliver final acceptance report and sign-off.

Acceptance checklist items (short):
- Signed MSA + Order Form
- PO reference provided to billing
- DPA agreed or redlined and accepted
- SOC 2 Type II summary uploaded to shared drive (link provided under NDA)

I'll draft the acceptance checklist and drop it into the MAP spreadsheet after we get your legal contacts for DPA.

Thanks,
Priyom
